cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(abba_family VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN ON)
set(AF_PREFIX_FLAGS "-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}=af-source -ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}=af-build")
add_compile_options("-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}=af-source" "-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}=af-build")
option(AF_SANITIZE "Address and Undefined sanitizers" OFF)
option(AF_TSAN "Thread sanitizer" OFF)
if(AF_SANITIZE AND AF_TSAN)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "ASan and TSan cannot be combined")
endif()
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(AF_SAN_FLAGS "")
if(AF_SANITIZE)
 set(AF_SAN_FLAGS "-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer")
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
elseif(AF_TSAN)
 set(AF_SAN_FLAGS "-fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer")
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=thread)
endif()
add_compile_options(-ffp-contract=off)
set(ZLIB_FILES adler32 compress crc32 deflate gzclose gzlib gzread gzwrite infback inffast inflate inftrees trees uncompr zutil)
set(ZLIB_SOURCES "")
foreach(f ${ZLIB_FILES})
 list(APPEND ZLIB_SOURCES vendor/zlib/${f}.c)
endforeach()
add_library(af_byte_zlib STATIC ${ZLIB_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(af_byte_zlib PUBLIC vendor/zlib)
target_compile_definitions(af_byte_zlib PRIVATE HAVE_UNISTD_H)
file(GLOB ZSTD_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS vendor/zstd/lib/common/*.c vendor/zstd/lib/compress/*.c vendor/zstd/lib/decompress/*.c vendor/zstd/lib/dictBuilder/*.c)
add_library(af_byte_zstd STATIC ${ZSTD_SOURCES})
target_compile_definitions(af_byte_zstd PRIVATE ZSTD_DISABLE_ASM)
target_include_directories(af_byte_zstd PUBLIC vendor/zstd/lib)
add_library(af_byte_bz2 STATIC vendor/bzip2/blocksort.c vendor/bzip2/huffman.c vendor/bzip2/crctable.c vendor/bzip2/randtable.c vendor/bzip2/compress.c vendor/bzip2/decompress.c vendor/bzip2/bzlib.c)
target_include_directories(af_byte_bz2 PUBLIC vendor/bzip2)
include(ExternalProject)
set(AF_XZ_HOST "")
if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
 set(AF_XZ_HOST --host=${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}-linux-gnu)
endif()
set(AF_XZ_LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xz-build/src/liblzma/.libs/liblzma.a)
ExternalProject_Add(af_xz_build SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/xz BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xz-build
 CONFIGURE_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env CC=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} "CFLAGS=-O2 -g -fPIC -ffp-contract=off" ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/xz/configure ${AF_XZ_HOST} --disable-shared --enable-static --disable-xz --disable-xzdec --disable-lzmadec --disable-lzmainfo --disable-lzma-links --disable-scripts --disable-doc --disable-nls
 BUILD_COMMAND make -j2 "CFLAGS=-O2 -g -fPIC -ffp-contract=off ${AF_PREFIX_FLAGS} ${AF_SAN_FLAGS}"
 INSTALL_COMMAND ""
 BUILD_BYPRODUCTS ${AF_XZ_LIB})
add_library(af_lzma STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(af_lzma PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION ${AF_XZ_LIB} INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/xz/src/liblzma/api)
add_dependencies(af_lzma af_xz_build)
file(GLOB CK_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS vendor/ckmeans/*.cpp)
add_library(af_ckmeans STATIC ${CK_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(af_ckmeans PUBLIC vendor/ckmeans)
set(AF_SOURCES src/math.cpp src/clustering.cpp src/models.cpp src/image.cpp src/symbols.cpp src/container.cpp src/api.cpp)
add_library(abba_family SHARED ${AF_SOURCES})
add_library(abba_family_static STATIC ${AF_SOURCES})
set(AF_DEPS af_ckmeans Threads::Threads af_byte_zlib af_lzma af_byte_bz2 af_byte_zstd)
foreach(t abba_family abba_family_static)
 target_include_directories(${t} PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include> PRIVATE vendor/ckmeans)
 target_link_libraries(${t} PRIVATE ${AF_DEPS})
 target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endforeach()
add_executable(abba_family_cli tools/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(abba_family_cli PRIVATE abba_family)
set_target_properties(abba_family_cli PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../lib")
install(TARGETS abba_family abba_family_static af_ckmeans af_byte_zlib af_byte_zstd af_byte_bz2 abba_family_cli LIBRARY DESTINATION lib ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES ${AF_XZ_LIB} DESTINATION lib RENAME libaf_lzma.a)
install(FILES include/abba_family.hpp include/abba_family_c.h include/af_json.hpp DESTINATION include)
include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
 add_executable(af_native_tests tests/native_tests.cpp)
 target_include_directories(af_native_tests PRIVATE src)
 target_link_libraries(af_native_tests PRIVATE abba_family Threads::Threads af_byte_zlib)
 add_test(NAME native_safety COMMAND af_native_tests)
endif()
if(AF_TSAN OR AF_SANITIZE)
 foreach(t abba_family_cli af_native_tests)
  if(TARGET ${t})
   target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -fno-pie)
   target_link_options(${t} PRIVATE -no-pie)
  endif()
 endforeach()
endif()
option(AF_FUZZ "Build libFuzzer driver (Clang)" OFF)
if(AF_FUZZ)
 foreach(t af_ckmeans af_byte_zlib af_byte_zstd af_byte_bz2 abba_family abba_family_static)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
 endforeach()
 add_executable(af_fuzz tools/fuzz.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(af_fuzz PRIVATE abba_family af_byte_zlib)
 target_compile_options(af_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
 target_link_options(af_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
endif()
add_executable(af_benchmark tools/benchmark.cpp)
target_link_libraries(af_benchmark PRIVATE abba_family)
